areas.title: End-to-end behavior
areas.description: Running the real command line against real projects.

areas.title: Release integrity
areas.description: Whether the published files are complete and unmodified.

areas.title: Speed and stability
areas.description: How long a repeated scan takes and whether it returns the same answer.

checks.title: Repeated scan speed and stability
checks.description: Runs the same scan several times and records timing.
proves: Repeated runs produced identical normalized output.
limitations: Timings are observations from one machine, not limits.

checks.title: Release files match their checksums
checks.description: Hashes every release file and compares it with SHA256SUMS.
proves: Every published file hashes to the recorded value.
limitations: Checksums prove the files were not altered after they were built.

checks.title: End-to-end scans of real projects
checks.description: Runs scan against pinned public repositories.
proves: Each ecosystem produces the dependency graph recorded in its golden file.
limitations: Golden files pin one revision of one example project per ecosystem.

evidence.title: Go module graph
evidence.description: Scans a pinned Go example project and compares the whole dependency graph with a recorded one.
proves: The Go detector resolves a build-tool-backed module graph.
limitations: The result depends on a compatible Go toolchain.
